_comment: Edit to control instant alerts. The watcher re-reads this file on every event — no restart needed. Group chats never alert unless matched by vip_senders/vip_keywords below.
_alert_all_dms_help: true = every 1:1 direct message (any network) fires an instant alert. Set false to alert ONLY on vip_senders/vip_keywords.
_vip_senders_help: People whose messages ALWAYS alert, even in group chats. Case-insensitive substring match against senderName OR senderID. e.g. "Mor Parag", "+15551234567", "boss".
_vip_keywords_help: Words/phrases that trigger an alert in ANY chat (group or DM). Case-insensitive substring vs message text. UTF-8 (Hebrew, etc.) works. e.g. "urgent", "invoice", "דחוף".
_mute_networks_help: network/accountID substrings to ignore for realtime alerts (the digest still covers them). e.g. ["linkedin", "twitter"].
_mute_chats_help: chatIDs or exact titles to never alert on, even if a VIP posts there. Useful to silence one specific noisy group.
